Longest chip selloff since 2006 hands short sellers $32 billion; Nasdaq falls 2%
events.summary: Chip stocks extended their longest losing streak since 2006, giving short sellers about $32 billion in paper gains, while the Nasdaq fell about 2% on Friday as doubts over AI returns deepened; chip-equipment stocks also posted historic losing streaks.

events.title: CoreWeave jumps on Goldman Sachs upgrade as AI stocks rebound; Nasdaq up over 1%
events.summary: CoreWeave shares jumped after a Goldman Sachs upgrade and AI-linked stocks recovered, lifting the Nasdaq more than 1% ahead of key earnings; Marvell rose 6% and Broadcom 3%.

events.title: Asian AI stocks crash: Kospi plunges about 8% triggering circuit breaker, Nikkei down about 5%
events.summary: After the hot US CPI, Korea's Kospi fell as much as 8.2% to 5,514.96, triggering a 20-minute circuit breaker (its 10th this year), while the Nikkei fell about 5% as AI and chip stocks tumbled amid AI financing worries including CoreWeave debt concerns.

events.title: GMO Internet to spend ¥26.1 billion on up to 116 Nvidia B300 servers
events.summary: Japan's GMO Internet plans to spend ¥26.1 billion on up to 116 Nvidia B300 servers.

events.title: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5%, beating forecasts; September retail sales up 1.1%
events.summary: China's GDP grew 4.5% y/y in Q3 (poll 4.4%, Q2 4.3%) and 1.2% q/q; September retail sales rose 1.1% (poll 0.5%) and industrial output 5.5%, while Jan-Sep fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% and property investment 20.6%.

events.title: TSMC Q3 net profit jumps 69% to record T$763.1 billion, beating estimates
events.summary: TSMC reported July-September net profit of T$763.1 billion, up about 69% year on year and above the T$746.3 billion LSEG SmartEstimate; revenue rose about 50% to T$1.49 trillion on AI chip demand. The result lands during a sharp global chip-stock selloff.

events.title: Saudi Arabia to postpone in-person 'Davos in the Desert' after Houthi attacks
events.summary: The FT reported Saudi Arabia will postpone the in-person Future Investment Initiative after Houthi attacks; Fars separately reported sirens and an explosion in Riyadh the same hour.

events.title: China proposes adding 40 AI, biotech and solar technologies to its export control list
events.summary: China's commerce ministry proposed adding 40 technologies, including AI models, agents and computing clusters, biomedicine and photovoltaic tech, to its catalogue of technologies prohibited or restricted from export; comments are open until Nov 15 and an interim registration requirement for transfers abroad takes effect immediately.

events.title: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

events.title: Taiwan to curb AI chip exports to China as part of US trade deal
events.summary: Bloomberg reported Taiwan will restrict exports of advanced AI chips to China under its trade deal with the US. Earlier reporting (June) said Taipei was weighing rules covering all Chinese customers and making smuggling a crime.

events.title: Chip index SOX posts longest losing streak since 2008 as AI worries deepen
events.summary: Yahoo Finance reports the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index ended the week on its longest losing streak since 2008; Opening Bell Daily put the week's chip-stock drop at about 12% through 16 October. Earlier this week Bloomberg noted roughly a 10% drop over six sessions.

events.title: Blackstone funds to invest $9 billion in Anthropic chip financing, FT reports
events.summary: Blackstone funds will invest $9 billion in a chip-financing vehicle backed by five-year lease payments from Anthropic, which offered a double-digit yield, the FT reports; it follows a roughly $35 billion Apollo/Blackstone chip-lease deal in June.

events.title: The Information: DeepSeek working with Huawei on AI chip designs for next year
events.summary: The Information reported DeepSeek is working with Huawei Technologies on new AI chip designs for next year.

events.title: Amazon opens AWS Trainium AI chips to all PyTorch developers
events.summary: Amazon said it is opening its Trainium AI chips to all PyTorch developers and will open-source TorchNeuron at the PyTorch conference on October 20.

events.title: Chip stocks bounce after the longest losing streak since 2008
events.summary: US semiconductor shares rebounded in premarket trade after the SOX index's longest losing streak since 2008, including a 3.83% fall on Friday.

events.title: Wall Street ends down sharply as AI-trade worries and high oil weigh
events.summary: US stocks closed sharply lower on Friday, Reuters reported, as the chip selloff and Brent near $110 weighed; the S&P 500 ended the week lower.

events.title: S&P Global flags potentially hidden AI debt at hyperscalers
events.summary: S&P Global warned that hyperscalers may carry hidden AI-related debt through off-balance-sheet structures as AI spending surges.

events.title: CoreWeave stock and bonds set for weekly plunge as rate-hike fears hit AI bets
events.summary: CoreWeave shares and bonds headed for a steep weekly decline as Fed rate-hike fears and worries about AI data-centre debt weighed on the neocloud.

events.title: Taiwan stocks open down more than 860 points after SOX falls 3.83%; central bank blames foreign selling for Taiwan dollar decline
events.summary: Taiwan's index opened down over 860 points to test 46,200 after the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 3.83%; Taiwan's central bank said the Taiwan dollar's recent decline mainly reflects foreign investors net selling Taiwan stocks and repatriating funds, and it will act as needed.

events.title: Germany to unveil Nvidia AI agreement next week, government sources say
events.summary: German government sources told Reuters that Berlin will unveil an AI agreement with Nvidia next week.

events.title: Samsung to use TSMC 3nm base dies for Nvidia's next-generation custom HBM, Seoul paper reports
events.summary: Reuters, citing the Seoul Economic Daily, said Samsung accepted Nvidia's request to use TSMC's 3nm process for NVHBM base dies and sixth-generation DRAM for core dies; Nvidia reportedly asked SK Hynix and Micron to do the same. No company confirmed it.

events.title: Arm and AMD fall about 5% as Qualcomm verdict adds to chip selloff
events.summary: Arm and AMD shares fell about 5% on Friday after a court verdict involving Qualcomm added to the chip selloff, and TSMC shares slipped.

web.title: TSMC September 2026 Revenue Report
web.takeaway: September revenue was NT$511.86 billion, down 0.6% from August and up 54.6% from a year earlier; year-to-date revenue is up 41.1%.

web.title: TSMC stock falls 2 days before earnings on a memory scare it doesn't face
web.takeaway: TSMC fell with an Asian chip selloff after a DRAM claim by China's CXMT hit SK Hynix (about -9%); TSMC does not make DRAM.

web.title: Dear Taiwan Semi Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for October 15
web.takeaway: Third-quarter results were due on 15 Oct after the US close; Wall Street expected about $4.45 a share per ADR on roughly $45.4 billion of revenue.
